channel.title: Contractor UK Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Contractor UK Limited (contractoruk.com)

item.title: A remote IT contractor's allowable expenses: 10 must-claims in 2026
item.description: Follow and file these 10 that HMRC says qualify to potentially drastically improve your bottom line as a limited company director who works from home.

item.title: Digital ID won’t be required for Right To Work, but more compulsion looms
item.description: A ‘hollowing out’ of the PM's digital identity policy is welcome — less so the future loss of the right to choose on Right To Work.

item.title: HMRC tax avoidance list ‘proves promoters’ nothing-to-lose mentality’
item.description: Advisers warn it’s still contractors who’ll carry the can, even if it is a ‘cat and mouse game between HMRC and promoters.’

item.title: What contractors should take from Honest Payroll Ltd’s failure
item.description: The strange, yet paradoxically not odd case of the folded umbrella, which looks both different and the same through a JSL lens.

item.title: Forget February as an MSC contractor seeking clarity, and maybe forget fairness altogether
item.description: Two cases brought by HMRC are now distinctly different, yet ‘judgement day’ for Churchill Knight and Boox contractors alike may not even fall this side of the decade.

item.title: How to run a contractor limited company — efficiently. Part one: software
item.description: Why great bookkeeping software is still a Personal Service Company’s secret weapon in the war on inefficiency.

item.title: Contractors, a £25million crackdown on rogue company directors is coming
item.description: Why for Personal Service Companies it’s not a case of ‘done nothing wrong so there’s nothing to worry about.’

item.title: Under the terms he was shackled by, Ray McCann’s Loan Charge Review probably is a fair resolution
item.description: While horizontal equity concerns linger (and may even warrant another government review), an extraordinary solution is now in the offing for loan charge contractors.

item.title: How EV tax changes of 2025-2028 add up for contractor limited company directors
item.description: With the era of Electric Vehicles as obvious tax wins drawing to a close, PSC contractors should refrain from locking themselves in.

item.title: April’s umbrella PAYE risk: how contractors’ end-clients are prepping
item.description: Far from ‘crossing their fingers,’ big users of brolly contractors are following a five-fold playbook to mitigate HMRC risk.
